caption: United States v. City of Newark
citation_line: United States v. City of Newark, No. 2:16-cv-01731 — Newark Police consent-decree administration and termination
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Arleo approved and supervised a federal consent decree governing Newark police stops, searches, arrests, use of force, bias-free policing, civilian oversight, training, data systems and accountability. After years of monitoring, she found substantial compliance and terminated the decree in 2025.
qualification_rationale: The matter reshaped the policies and accountability systems of New Jersey’s largest police department. Its significance rests on nearly a decade of institutional reform and judicial supervision, not on a single appellate holding.
appellate_posture_note: The decree was terminated after the court found substantial compliance. No appellate merits disposition was identified; the career significance derives from the decree’s breadth, duration and practical effect.
